use_when: a justified Task Pod has a bounded specialist responsibility that host-native/project-local roles do not cover well
one or a few concrete role procedures materially improve specialization, context isolation, or independent review
avoid_when: the blocker is a missing tool/API/runtime, credential, environment, authorization, or product decision
the full catalog would be installed without a concrete role boundary
role content would be treated as authority over project/user intent

minimal_commands: inspect the exact role files required by the current Task Pod
use the upstream installer/adapter only for the selected host and selected role subset when supported
notes: Prefer host-native/project-local specialists first; this provider is optional.
Do not expose all roles to the active context merely because the repository contains them.
Record the concrete upstream commit when selected role content materially affects a consequential decision or release.
Role files are procedural prompts. They do not grant tools, credentials, network access, runtime capability, or project authority.

permissions: network access to GitHub when fetching/updating the provider
local write access only to the selected host agent/role configuration surface when installation is actually needed

checks: confirm the selected role corresponds to a real responsibility boundary in the current Task Pod
confirm no more roles were installed/loaded than required
record the upstream revision for material use
verify the specialist returns bounded evidence/output to the accountable owner
verify role use did not bypass Working Contract decision ownership or AAOP autonomy policy

steps: remove only the role files/config proven to have been added for this adoption
remove temporary provider checkout if no longer needed

warnings: More roles are not more capability. Default to one agent and use at most five Task Pod members.
A role library is not a second orchestration control plane and never owns Journey or Working Contract state.
Community role content can evolve independently; review the exact selected revision before consequential reliance.
